articles.title: UAE E-Invoicing Turns Finance Change Into Provider Readiness Gates
claimRiskNotes: This is a dated correction to an existing article, not a new 2026-08-31 flagship article.
The ASP appointment extension is described as a deadline extension, while the mandatory implementation date remains unchanged.
The ASP count is treated as provider-list evidence, not proof of implementation readiness across buyers, suppliers, ERPs or exception flows.
